zh.name: 极简风 · 数据盘点
zh.summary: 用醒目的数字和逐项说明，展示一段时间的投入、收获与变化。
zh.useWhen: 月度总结、独居生活、习惯记录和项目里程碑。
zh.instructions: 提供主题、记录周期、同口径的指标、单位和一条可保留的经验。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Minimal Period Recap
en.summary: Review a period with one key figure, a clear breakdown, and what you will carry forward.
en.useWhen: Monthly recaps, habit tracking, personal logs, and project milestones.
en.instructions: Provide the period, comparable metrics, units, and what you learned.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
